user.title: Connect your Perdis duty roster
user.description:
How do you want to find your portal?

Unofficial integration: INIT does not document the Perdis interfaces, so it reads what the portal shows you in the browser. Your password stays in Home Assistant.

menu_options.operator: Pick my transit company from the list

operator.title: Your transit company
operator.description: These companies run a public Perdis WebComm portal. Yours is missing? Go back and enter the address you open in the browser.

manual.title: Address of your Perdis portal
manual.description: Copy the address from the browser, e.g. `https://perdis.example.org/WebComm/`. A plain host name works too.

data_description.base_url: The page where you sign in with your personnel number.
data_description.portal_type: Choose WebComm unless your company gave you an AppComm service address.
data_description.verify_ssl: Only switch off for portals with a self-signed certificate.

credentials.title: Sign in to {operator}
credentials.description: Use the same user name and password as on {url}. They are only sent to that portal.

reauth_confirm.title: Password changed?
reauth_confirm.description: The portal {url} no longer accepts the password of {username}. Enter the current one.

error.invalid_auth: The portal did not accept the user name or password.
error.cannot_connect: The portal could not be reached. Check the address and your internet connection.
error.not_a_portal: This address answers, but not like a Perdis portal. Check the address and the kind of portal.
error.invalid_url: This is not a valid web address.
error.unknown: Unexpected error, see the log for details.

abort.already_configured: This account is already set up.

init.title: Your personal times
init.description: These values only affect what Home Assistant works out from your roster.

data.lookback_days: Days to keep in the past
data.detail_days: Fetch exact shift times for this many days ahead

data_description.wake_up_lead_minutes: Sets the wake-up time and its trigger.
data_description.commute_minutes: Sets the leave-home time and its trigger.
data_description.minimum_rest_hours: A shorter rest switches on the short rest warning (EU rule: 11 hours).
data_description.scan_interval: Rosters rarely change by the minute; 30 minutes is plenty.
data_description.detail_days: Only the month roster is free; each shift's exact times need one extra request per day. 0 turns it off.
data_description.person: Used as context and passed to a notification/script you set below.
data_description.notify_target: A service such as notify.mobile_app_phone or a script.my_script to call on a roster change. Leave empty to use only the repair-style notification.

advanced.name: Pages of the portal (advanced)
advanced.description: Leave empty: the integration finds the pages in the portal menu by itself. Fill in a path only if a page is not found (see the diagnostics).

refresh.name: Refresh roster
refresh.description: Asks the portal for the roster now instead of waiting for the next check.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: Leave empty to refresh every account.

get_duties.name: Get duties
get_duties.description: Returns the duties between two days, e.g. for a script or a notification.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: Leave empty to get the duties of every account.

end_date.name: Until
end_date.description: Last day; two weeks after the first day when empty.

swap_request.name: Request a duty swap
swap_request.description: Enters a swap request for a shift in the portal (or only checks it first).

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: The account, if you have more than one.

start_date.name: From
start_date.description: First day of the shift to swap.

end_date.name: Until
end_date.description: Last day; same as the first day when empty.

partner.name: Swap partner
partner.description: Personnel number of a specific colleague, if required.

validate_only.name: Only check
validate_only.description: Ask the portal whether the swap is allowed without entering it.

swap_accept.name: Accept a duty swap
swap_accept.description: Accepts an offered swap by its id (see the Open duty swaps sensor).

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: The account, if you have more than one.

swap_id.name: Swap
swap_id.description: The id of the swap to accept.

swap_reject.name: Reject a duty swap
swap_reject.description: Rejects an offered swap by its id.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: The account, if you have more than one.

swap_id.name: Swap
swap_id.description: The id of the swap to reject.

swap_withdraw.name: Withdraw a duty swap
swap_withdraw.description: Withdraws a swap request you entered earlier, by its id.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: The account, if you have more than one.

swap_id.name: Swap
swap_id.description: The id of the swap request to withdraw.

end_before_start.message: The last day lies before the first day.

choose_account.message: Several accounts are set up; name the account for the swap.

swaps_unsupported.message: This portal does not offer duty swaps.
